description: Planted trees integrated with annual cropland. Alley cropping, tree intercropping and planted cropland boundaries remain distinct implementation variants within this existing family.
Protect and manage natural regrowth on farmland. Farmer-managed natural regeneration, parkland tree retention and on-farm assisted regeneration remain recorded variants.

Forest recovery through spontaneous regeneration after degrading pressures are removed. Includes passive natural regeneration and secondary succession; assisted regeneration remains a separate family.

Establish forest through planting. Reforestation, afforestation and enrichment remain explicit variants: retain prior land cover, existing canopy and safeguards against conversion of natural non-forest ecosystems. Production plantations remain separate.

Create or reconstruct a wetland on land currently classified outside the wetland system. Retain source-specific site history and water requirements; restoration and rewetting remain separate families.

Collect runoff from a separate catchment. Storage, recharge and alluvial-storage purposes remain distinct within the existing family; this grouping does not pool their suitability rules. Macro-catchment water harvesting is the umbrella label, not an additional intervention.
Evidence applying across agroforestry families, or not isolated to one family. This is an evidence grouping, not an intervention choice.
